faq.q1: Is this white-hat, Google-safe link building?
faq.a1: Yes — manual outreach, guest posting, and broken-link replacement only. No PBNs, link farms, or paid link schemes that risk a Google penalty.
faq.q2: How many backlinks will I get per month?
faq.a2: Quality over quantity — typically 4-10 high-authority links per month depending on your niche and plan, rather than a high-volume, low-quality count.
faq.q3: How do you choose which sites to get links from?
faq.a3: We vet every prospective site for topical relevance, real organic traffic, and domain authority, and run a spam-score check before outreach.
faq.q4: How long until link building affects my rankings?
faq.a4: Backlinks typically take 2-4 months to fully influence rankings as Google recrawls and indexes them, then re-evaluates trust and authority signals.
